# f5xc_ike_phase2_profile (Resource)

IKE Phase2 profile mainly includes the following<br>1. Encryption protocols to be used for IKE SA<br>2. Authentication Protocols to be used for IKE SA<br>3. DH group (if PFS is enabled)<br>4. Key lifetime etc

To get more information about f5xc_ike_phase2_profile, refer:

- [API documentation](https://docs.cloud.f5.com/docs-v2/api/views-ike-phase2-profile)

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Example: Ike Phase2 Profile - Full

resource "f5xc_ike_phase2_profile" "example" {
  name        = "example-ike-phase2-profile"
  namespace   = "default"
  description = "Full IKE phase2 profile example"

  labels = {
    env = "example"
  }

  annotations = {
    owner = "network"
  }

  encryption_algos     = ["AES256_GCM", "AES192_GCM"]
  authentication_algos = ["AUTH_ALG_NONE", "SHA384_HMAC"]

  pfs_mode_choice = {
    dh_group_set = {
      dh_groups = ["DH_GROUP_19", "DH_GROUP_20"]
    }
  }

  ike_key_lifetime_choice = {
    ike_keylifetime_minutes = {
      duration = 180
    }
  }
}
```
